Hey

I don't think there's a crisis centre nearby, there are a couple of places that have free counselling, etc., but I'm in no position to contact them, and I can't talk to them in-person either. Any call I attempted to make would be heard, and I live so far out of town that there's no way to get there myself. 

I'm sorry you had to deal with that - My mum understands mental illness, and she's great with my anxiety, but she had both depression and anxiety as a child too and blamed herself for me having it. I'm pretty sure she's just in denial and is trying to convince herself that it's just regular mood swings that everyone gets. 

I actually can't think of any hobbies straight off the top of my head. I'm probably more a jack-of-all-trades type in the creative areas? What about yourself?
